s1.expectation: I'm in the #general chat room of the Accessibility Testin's server.
s1.cue: The '# general' name right at the top next to the back arrow, and the big bold 'Welcome to Accessibility Testin's server' line. The message box also says 'Message #general'.

first_pass.why: Nothing is moving, the name sits at the top where my eye lands first, and it's repeated in the message box. I got it in a second.

s2.expectation: Same as before, I'm in #general in the Accessibility Testin's server.
s2.cue: '# general' at the top and the bold welcome line with the server name.

first_pass.why: Still, calm screen, place name top left, plenty of white space around it.

s3.expectation: I'm looking at the Accessibility Testin's server and its list of channels, with #general picked.
s3.cue: The big server name at the top, the purple 'ATs' tile lit up on the left strip, and the grey highlight on '# general'.

first_pass.why: The server name is big and first, and I can see which server tile and which channel are lit up. There's a lot of little icons but nothing moves.

s4.expectation: I'm in my Messages, the direct messages part.
s4.cue: The big 'Messages' title at the top and the chat bubble icon lit up in purple on the left strip.

first_pass.why: Short bold title up top, the matching icon is highlighted, lots of white space. The cartoon is still, so it doesn't pull me away.

s5.expectation: Back on the Accessibility Testin's server channel list, #general selected.
s5.cue: Server name at the top, the lit-up 'ATs' tile, the grey band on '# general'.

first_pass.why: Same clear layout as before, name at the top, highlight shows what's picked.

s6.expectation: I'm starting to make a new server, choosing whether to make my own or use a template.
s6.cue: The big 'Create Your Server' heading and the X in the corner that tells me it's a task I can close.

first_pass.why: One bold heading, a short line under it, a clean list. I know exactly what I'm doing here.

s7.where: Tell Us More About Your Server
s7.expectation: I'm in the middle of setting up a new server, answering whether it's for friends or a club.
s7.cue: The bold heading 'Tell Us More About Your Server' and the question under it.

first_pass.why: The heading says exactly what this step is. I don't know how many steps are left, which nags at me, but I know where I am.

s8.expectation: I'm on the naming step of creating my server, with the name already filled in.
s8.cue: 'Create Your Server' heading, the 'Server Name' box and the 'Create Server' button.

first_pass.why: Heading at the top, one box, one button. Simple and still.

s9.where: Enable Permissions pop-up over Create Your Server
s9.expectation: A pop-up asking about photo permissions, on top of the Create Your Server screen.
s9.cue: 'Enable Permissions' in bold in the white box, and I can still read 'Create Your Server' greyed behind it.

first_pass.why: I can see both the pop-up's name and the screen underneath, so I know where I'll land when I close it.

s10.expectation: Creating my server, on the naming step, but the name box is empty now.
s10.cue: 'Create Your Server' heading and the 'Server Name' label.

first_pass.why: The heading is still there and clear. The empty box is fine, I know what I'm doing.

s11.expectation: The photo permissions pop-up again, over the create server screen.
s11.cue: 'Enable Permissions' heading in the pop-up, 'Create Your Server' visible behind.

first_pass.why: Same as before, the pop-up names itself and the screen behind is readable.

s12.expectation: I've made the server and now it's asking me to invite people with a link.
s12.cue: Big bold 'Add some people' and the invite link box.

first_pass.why: Clear heading, one thing to do, a Skip button. Nothing moving.

s13.expectation: Same invite screen, adding people to my new server.

first_pass.why: Same calm screen, heading does the job.

s14.expectation: Still on the invite screen, and I've just copied the link.
s14.cue: 'Add some people' heading, plus the 'Link Copied!' bubble at the top.

first_pass.why: The heading is still there and I can tell where I am. Out of scope, but the 'Link Copied!' bubble and the clipboard pop-up in the bottom corner grab my eye first - pop-ins like that pull me off.

s15.expectation: I'm in the settings for my invite link.
s15.cue: 'Link Settings' title at the top, and the 'Invite Channel' #general card under it.

first_pass.why: Title centred at the top, sections with clear grey headings. Easy.

s16.expectation: Back on the invite screen, now it says Done instead of Skip.

first_pass.why: Same clear heading.

s17.cue: 'Expire After' at the top of the white sheet, and 'Link Settings' greyed behind it.

first_pass.why: The sheet names itself and I can see the screen it came from. The ticked 30 days matches.

s18.where: Max Uses choice over Link Settings
s18.expectation: Picking how many times the invite link can be used, inside Link Settings.
s18.cue: 'Max Uses' heading on the sheet, 'Link Settings' behind.

first_pass.why: Same as the last one, clear name on the sheet.

s19.expectation: Link Settings again, I've switched on Temporary Membership and now there's a Save button.

first_pass.why: Title is clear. I like that Save showed up so I know I changed something.

s20.expectation: Back in #general in the Accessibility Testin's server.
s20.cue: '# general' at the top, the welcome line with the server name, 'Message #general' box.

first_pass.why: Name top left, still screen, got it immediately.

s21.where: server channel list with Setup Progress
s21.expectation: The Accessibility Testin's server channel list, now with a 'Setup Progress' card on top.
s21.cue: Server name at the top, lit-up ATs tile, '# general' highlighted.

first_pass.why: Same clear name at the top. I like 'Step 1 of 4' - that tells me how far through setup I am.

s22.expectation: I think this is my own profile page.
s22.cue: The big bold name 'Accessibility Testing' with the avatar, and the 'Edit Profile' button under it. The 'Main' tab is underlined.

first_pass.why: The big heading is a person's name, not the name of the place, so I have to work it out from the Edit Profile button. And honestly my eye went straight to the 'Get Nitro' button with a stripe across it and the 'Can't wait for...' bubble - it looks like it changes (the next picture says 'Shower thought?'), and that kind of thing pulls me right off.
first_pass.solution: Put the word 'Profile' or 'My Profile' at the top. And stop the shimmer on Get Nitro and the changing bubble text, or let me turn them off.

test_cases.action: Open the page that has your own name as its big heading: tap your name at the bottom-left of the column of rooms, beside the round picture. Scroll the page down and back up. Then look away for a few seconds, look back, and say, from the top of the screen only, which page you are on. Leave with the X at the top-left.
test_cases.real_if: at every scroll position nothing at the top names the page
test_cases.not_real_if: a page name appears somewhere as you scroll, or you can say which page it is from the top alone
test_cases.observed_result: I tapped my name at the bottom-left and the page slid up from the bottom. At the top there's an X, a black band, my round picture, and a thought bubble saying 'What are you currently obsessed with?'. Under that is my big name 'Accessibility Testing' and a blue 'Edit Profile' button. I scrolled down: the X and the black band went away and the top showed my picture and the bubble. When I scrolled back up, the X came back. At no point did any word at the top name the page. I looked away and back, and from the top alone I'd say 'something about me, maybe my profile' - but that's a guess from my picture and name, not because the page tells me. The only word that gets close is 'Profile' inside the 'Edit Profile' button, which is a button, not a title. This time there was no shimmering 'Get Nitro' button, and the bubble text was different from both of my pictures, so it does change. I left with the X and was back on Messages.

s22.closing_comment: Still nothing at the top that says 'Profile' at any scroll position. I work it out from my own name and the Edit Profile button. The bubble text changes each time I come back, which pulls my eye. The shimmery Nitro button wasn't there this time, so that part is smaller than I thought, but the missing page name stands.

first_pass.solution: A plain 'Profile' title at the top, and keep the bubble and the Nitro button still.

test_cases.not_real_if: the page name comes back within a second or two and stays

test_cases.action: Open the 'general' room (tap an 'ATs' square, then '# general'). Tap the magnifying glass at the top-right. Type the word hello and nothing else. Look away for a few seconds, look back, and say where you are. Leave with the back arrow.
test_cases.real_if: nothing on the screen tells you that you are searching, and in which room
test_cases.not_real_if: you can say from the screen that you are searching, and where
test_cases.observed_result: I tapped the first 'ATs' square, then '# general', and got the #general room. I tapped the magnifying glass at the top-right. At first the screen looked just like my picture: a box with a small 'in: general' chip and the Members / Media / Pins tabs under it. Then I typed hello. The tabs and the member list went away and I got a search box that reads 'in: general  hello', with a magnifying glass on the left and a clear-X on the right, and the message 'We searched far and wide. Unfortunately, no results were found.' I looked away and looked back, and from the screen I could say 'I'm searching for hello in #general'. The magnifying glass, the 'in: general' chip and the 'We searched...' line together tell me. I left with the back arrow and was back in #general.

s32.closing_comment: Right after tapping the magnifying glass it really does look like the channel info page, with only the small 'in: general' chip to go on. That first moment is still a bit confusing. But once I type anything it clearly turns into a search in #general with a 'no results' message, so I'd only be confused for a moment.

first_pass.why: Honestly, my attention is on the wall of GIFs, not on anything that names the place. They're moving pictures - screaming faces, a baby, fireworks - filling the whole screen. The word 'Trending' is small and 'general' is dimmed, so I had to hunt for them.
first_pass.solution: Let me stop the GIFs playing until I tap one, or respect my reduce-motion setting. And make 'Trending GIFs in #general' bigger at the top.

test_cases.action: Open the 'general' room and tap the smiling face in the message box to open the picture panel. Tap 'GIFs'. Drag the small handle at the top of the panel upward so the panel fills the screen. Tap 'Trending GIFs' and say where you are. Then use the small back arrow to return to the GIFs list, tap the panel's search box, type hello, and say where you are again. Do not tap any picture. Press Back once to close.
test_cases.real_if: at those points you cannot find anything on the screen that tells you where you are
test_cases.not_real_if: you can find something on the screen that tells you where you are
test_cases.observed_result: I opened #general, tapped the smiling face and then 'GIFs', and dragged the handle up so the panel filled the screen. The first thing I noticed were the tiles: the pictures behind the words ('hello', 'yes', 'sorry' and so on) changed between my looks, so they are moving. Then I tapped 'Trending GIFs'. The whole screen filled with playing GIFs (a man in a taco hat, dancing coffee cups, baseball players), and they were visibly different frames each time I looked. When I made myself look for where I was, I found a small '< Trending' line at the top of the panel, the shaded 'GIFs' tab above it, and '# general' dimmed right at the top. I used the small back arrow to get back to the GIFs list, tapped the search box and typed hello. The screen filled with moving hello GIFs (a waving man, a dancing lizard, a cat). The only things saying where I was: the word 'hello' in the search box, the shaded 'GIFs' tab, and the dimmed '# general'. Pressing Back once only closed the keyboard strip, so I pressed Back once more a few seconds later and the panel closed. I was back in #general with the message box empty. I didn't tap any picture and nothing was sent.

s43.closing_comment: I can find '< Trending', the GIFs tab and the dimmed '# general' if I make myself look. But the whole screen is moving pictures and my attention goes there first, every time. The words that tell me where I am are small and grey next to all that motion. I'd want the GIFs still until I touch them, or my reduce-motion setting respected.
